S.Fuentes, Uotila & Borsch |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:77121009-1 |access-date=2022-06-28 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Chenopodiastrum hybridum'' (Maple-leaved goosefoot) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/AMAR/Chenopodiastrum_hybridum.php|access-date=2022-02-15|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
